item.title: Remy 0.1.2
item.description:
New

  • Automatic updates. Remy now keeps itself up to date. It checks once a day, and you can check any time from … → Check for Updates…. When an update is ready, Remy shows a badge in the Dock and a notification. It never interrupts what you're doing.

Note

  • This is the first version with automatic updates. If you're on 0.1.0 or 0.1.1, install this one by hand once; future updates arrive on their own.
